title: The Silent Thorn
author: Hazel Okafor
blurb: Wendell Oyelaran, the youngest member of a dying guild, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
